review_scope: All 36 panels in the three declared galleries: 18 RGB and 18 corresponding owner overlays; not all 600 images individually reviewed.
observations: Expected 4/5/6/7/7/6 animals visible in the six selected groups. No obvious missing-body, merged-owner or widespread facility-label inclusion observed at displayed resolution.
Within each group A/B preserve camera, animal placement and owner colors. Appearance variation is modest in these galleries; this review does not quantify the full-corpus lighting distribution.
C shows the front gate occluding foreground bodies; overlay remains on visible animal regions and is interrupted by the bars rather than painting the bars as animal.
The two original layout-failure groups 7 and 10 are visible with separated bodies; the original failed layouts and runs remain failed.

Body/pose/environment family remains narrow, poses repeat, layout is relatively sparse, and the external ground slab/dark background are synthetic. No photorealism, crowd-contact or real-domain representativeness claim is made.
acceptance_scope: Finite frozen RLPL correspondence corpus engineering review only, together with 1024 full byte/source/schedule checks. Synthetic owner labels remain prohibited as normal segmentation targets.
